_comment: All clinical cut-offs live here so they can be reviewed without touching code. Adult patients only.

critical._comment: Emergency (suspected ESI 1): call for immediate help.

veryUrgent._comment: Very urgent (about ESI 2). Reduced alertness also lands here.

urgent._comment: Urgent (about ESI 3). Includes the ESI danger-zone vitals.

standard._comment: Standard (about ESI 4): mildly abnormal. Anything below is Non-urgent.

painScale._comment: Piecewise-linear map from the raw expression score (sum of AU4, AU6/7 and AU9/10 blendshapes, 0..3) to 0-10.

quality._comment: minFps gates the start of a measurement; below the unclear* values the result is 'Unclear'.
